{{Quote|Try to keep up, clone.|Tae Boon, to Stak|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
'''Tae Boon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a second in command to [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] of the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When Boon's [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrg]] nipped at the fingers of the [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF trooper]] [[Stak/Legends|Stak]], he told him in [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] that his blurrg may be short-tempered, but that she was faster than his [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]]. He later teased one of the passing ARF troopers, telling him to "try and keep up" on his AT-RT while he himself rode his blurrg.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tae Boon was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]].
